correctness.rationale: Under record-bias weight theta^R with theta=lambda*n for fixed lambda>0, the independent rank insertion U_i law yields record indicators B_i=1{U_i=i} and descent indicators X_i=1{U_{i+1}<=U_i}, a bounded 1-dependent triangular array. The proof computes exact r_i,p_i,j_i=Pr(X_i=X_{i+1}=1), derives the finite covariance -theta*n*(n-1)/[2(theta+n-1)^2] by exponential-family differentiation of known ED, and integrates Riemann-limit variances: Sigma11=lambda log(1+1/lambda)-lambda/(1+lambda), Sigma12=-lambda/[2(1+lambda)^2], Sigma22=(6lambda^2+4lambda+1)/[12(1+lambda)^3]. Its conditional three-rank argument gives strict positive definiteness; gap-separated blocks of n^(1/4) produce the Lindeberg–Cramer–Wold joint Gaussian limit. Independent weighted permutation enumeration for n=2..7 and theta=1/2,2,3 verified exact means/covariances; symbolic integration checked the descent variance integrand; these finite tests are not an n->infinity proof.
